name: voice-invoice-consolidated
description: Consolidated Voice Invoice & Contract Generation Backend

scripts.stop: bash -c 'PID=$(lsof -ti:3000 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$PID" ]; then echo "No server running on port 3000"; else kill -9 $PID 2>/dev/null && echo "Server stopped"; fi'
scripts.restart: npm run stop && sleep 1 && npm start
scripts.run: bash -c 'PID=$(lsof -ti:3000 2>/dev/null); if [ ! -z "$PID" ]; then kill -9 $PID 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; fi; node server.js'
